status.scope_reason: The company is a dedicated manufacturer specializing entirely in the R&D, production, and sales of hollow plant-based empty capsule shells.
status.evidence: According to the company's official profile, Yantai Oriental Pharmacap Co., Ltd. is an innovative enterprise specializing in the production and sales of HPMC plant capsules.

claims.claim: The company registered its primary production project under a Chinese national invention patent (No. ZL2005100596701) in 2008, which specifically covers the development and manufacturing of HPMC plant-compound capsules.

The company reports the development and commercial manufacturing of Enterosoluble HPMC Empty Capsules, which are engineered to resist disintegration in gastric juice and dissolve specifically in enteric solutions according to Yopccapsules Product Category.

The company reports that its research and development on HPMC plant-compound/complex capsules utilizing natural seaweed or algae was granted a Chinese national invention patent in 2008 as disclosed on Drugdu Company Profile.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its research and development on HPMC plant-compound/complex capsules utilizing natural seaweed or algae was granted a Chinese national invention patent in 2008 as disclosed on Made-in-China Company Profile.
claims.note: The Drugdu Company Profile mentions purely natural materials but does not explicitly mention seaweed or algae; this detail is instead disclosed on its Made-in-China company profiles.
claims.source: Drugdu Company Profile and Made-in-China Company Profile

claims.claim: The company reports an annual production capacity of 30 billion plant capsules from its manufacturing headquarters in the Yantai Haiyang Economic and Technical Development Zone, China, which covers an area of 60,000 square meters.
claims.source: Yopccapsules About Us and Natural Health Products NZ Summit 2025 Exhibitor Profile

claims.claim: According to an independent report by the United States International Trade Commission, Yantai Oriental Pharmacap Co., Ltd. started its second-phase project in 2022, which involved an investment of over $21 million (150 million yuan) in 26,000 square meters of manufacturing space to scale its total annual output to 30 billion plant-based capsules.
claims.source: United States International Trade Commission Publication 5696 (February 2026)

claims.claim: Yantai Oriental Pharmacap Co., Ltd. holds third-party EXCiPACT certification issued by Bureau Veritas for its manufacturing site at No. 20 Shenzhen Street, Haiyang Development Zone, Yantai City, China, verifying its adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) requirements for pharmaceutical excipients.

The company reports a total investment of 150 million yuan for its second-phase project, which establishes a total construction area of 26,000 square meters and yields an annual output capacity of 30 billion plant-based capsules, as detailed on the Yantai Oriental Pharmacap Official News Portal.

Preqin reports that in January 2026, Yantai Oriental Pharmacap Co., Ltd. closed a Series A funding round from investor Donghe Venture Capital to expand its production capacity and market share, as documented on the Preqin Asset Profile Registry.

The company reports operating a 60,000 square meter professional capsule manufacturing facility located at No. 20 Shenzhen Street, Haiyang Economic and Technical Development Zone, Yantai City, Shandong Province, China, as detailed in its Official Company Contact Profile.

The company reports that its second-phase expansion project involves a total investment of 150 million yuan and a construction area of 26,000 square meters to achieve an annual capacity of 30 billion plant capsules, as announced in its Official Corporate News Archive.

The company reports reaching an annual production capacity of 30 billion plant-based capsules following the launch of its phase-two facility expansion project, which added 26,000 square meters of construction area.
claims.source: Yantai Oriental Pharmacap Co., Ltd. Official Website and USITC Report (Hard Empty Capsules from Brazil, China, India, and Vietnam)

claims.claim: According to primary research, in January 2026, Yantai Oriental Pharmacap Co., Ltd. closed a Series A funding round from investor Donghe Venture Capital to expand its production capacity and market share.
claims.note: The Series A funding round, investor Donghe Venture Capital, and January 2026 timeline could not be confirmed in available sources.
claims.source: Yantai Oriental Pharmacap Co., Ltd. Official Site
